text.body:
oṃ bhadrakālīpratiṣṭhā <ṛE-30604>
(front page is blank) (f.1a 1st line) ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi cāmuṇḍāsthāpanaṃ param| grāmādau paṭṭaṇevāpi parvatāgre vaneṣu ca|| bhutapretapiśācāśca gandharvamṛgarākṣasāḥ| tat grāme tat(2nd line) bhayaṅghoraṃ vinaśyati na saṃśayaḥ|| (bhvaramāri) praveśañca mahāsphoṭakanāśanaṃ| abhasmāravināśañca mahādoṣavināśanam|| cāmuṇḍāsthāpanañcaivagrāmādiṣu viśeṣataḥ|(3rd line) navakoṭi mahāśakti devānāñca strayāvaham|| tanmadhyetu cāmuṇḍā mahāśakti mahāgraṇi| grāmādausthāpanaṃ yāṃ yāṃ rāgśa(kṣa)sam sthāpaṇaṃśubham||(4th line) uttarāyaṇakāletu śuklapakṣe śubhedine| sumuhurte sulagne ca devīmāvāhya pūjayet|| aṣṭādaśavidhānena mṛtsaṅgrahaṇapūrvakaṃ(5th line) | yāgaśālāṃ tataḥkṛtvā pūrvoktavidhināsaha|| āyāmauvedivistāraṃ dvihastaṃ vā trihastakaṃ| caturhastaṃ yathākāryaṃ darpaṇodarasannibhaṃ||(6th line)
kuṇḍāni paritaḥkuryāt pūrvādiṣu viśeṣataḥ| pūrvādi uttarāntaṃ padmakuṇḍaṃ viśeṣataḥ|| īśāne devikuṇḍantu yonyākāreṇakalpayet (7th line) | gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuru|| athaḥ guruḥ mūrtipaiḥ kṛtanityāhnikadvayaḥ sahitomakhālayaṃ gatvā udanmukho rucirāsanasthaḥ(F.1b 1st line ) prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā| bhadrakālīṃ ddhyātvātadanujñāṃ vibhāvya|vighneśvarapūjāpurassaraṃ saṅkalpaṃ puṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā prokṣya| indrapāvakayormaddhyenityavat śivasūryaṃ(2nd line) sampūjyā visṛjyaivasamācamya| sakalīkṛtya sāmānyārghyaṃ saṃsāddhya| arghyapātraṃ svakareṇa grīhītvā| maṇḍapātbāhye stthitvā pūrvadvāramastreṇasamprokṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhya| toraṇamaddhye (3rd line) oṃ hāṃ śāntitoraṇāsanāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ śāntitoraṇamūrtaye namaḥ nīlavastrāṅgarāgañca dvibhujāñjalibandhakam| karāla vadanaṃśyāmaṃ ddhyāyedvai śāntitoraṇam|| oṃ hāṃ (4th line) śāntitoraṇāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ śāntitoraṇādhipataye bhadrāya namaḥ| toraṇaśākhayoḥ śyāmavarṇaṃdvinetraṃ ca ekavaktrañcaturbhujaṃ| gaṇḍyākṣamālā ṛgvedamañjaliṃdadhata namaḥ|| (5th line) namaḥ oṃ hāṃ ṛgvedāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ kṛtayugāya namaḥ| triśūle oṃ hāṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| narmadāyai namaḥ(6th line) dvārottarapatākāyām praśāntāya namaḥ| dvāradakṣiṇapatākāyāṃ oṃ hāṃ śiśirāya namaḥ| ūrddhvodumbare oṃ hāṃgaṇapataye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ(7th line) | oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| dakṣiṇottaraśākhayoḥ oṃ hāṃ nandine namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ ādiśaktyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahākālāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ padaniśaktyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ indrāya namaḥ(8th line) | oṃ hāṃ dehinīśaktyai namaḥ| adhodumbare oṃ hāṃ astrāya dvārapālakāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ durgāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ kavargāya namaḥ| dvāroparisthitaddhvaje oṃ hāṃ somāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ budhāya namaḥ|(F.2a 1st line ) eteṣāṃ gandhādibhissampūjya āgneyadhvaje oṃ hāṃ agnaye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ svāhādevyai namaḥ arghyaṃdatvā| dakṣiṇadvāramastreṇasaṃprokṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhya toraṇamaddhye(2rd line) oṃ hāṃ bhūtitoraṇāsanāya namaḥ| oṃ hām bhūtitoraṇamurtaye namaḥ | dvibhujañca dvinetrañca kṛṣṇābharaṇa bhūṣitam| bhūtitoraṇamākhyātaṃ stūlagrīvaṃ mahodaram|| oṃ hāṃ bhūtitoraṇāya namaḥ|(3rd line) oṃ hāṃ bhūtitoraṇādhipataye vijayāya namaḥ| toraṇaśākhayoḥ raktavarṇaṃdvinetraṃ ca śuklayajñopavītinam| sṛtkuṇḍikāñjlibhūtaṃ yajurvedaṃ vibhāvayet|(4th line) oṃ hāṃ yajurvedāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ tretāyugāya namaḥ| triśule oṃ hāṃ manonmaṇyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sindhave namaḥ| dvārapūrvapatākāyāṃ(5th line ) oṃ hāṃ parjanyāya namaḥ| dvārapascimapatākāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ aśokāya namaḥ| ūrddhvodumbare oṃ hāṃ ganapataye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| (6th line)
purvapaścimaśākhayoḥ oṃ hāṃ hlādiniśaktyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ vināyakāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ vallabhāyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ yamāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ kālakaṇṭhyai namaḥ| adhodumbare oṃ hāṃ astrāyadvārapālakāya namaḥ|(7th line) oṃ hāṃ cavargāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ ṭavargāya namaḥ| dvāroparisthitaddhvaje oṃ hāṃ bṛhaspataye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ bhārgavāya namaḥ| niṝtikoṇaddhvaje oṃ hāṃ niṝtaye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ dehiniśaktyai namaḥ |(8th line) oṃ hāṃ viṣṇave namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| vāstvādhipataye brahmaṇe namaḥ| saṃpūjya ||pascimadvāratoraṇamastreṇa samprokṣya| kavacenāvakuṇṭhya(F.2b 1st line) toraṇamaddhye oṃ hāṃ balatoraṇāsanāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ balatoraṇamurtaye namaḥ| raktavarṇaṃ dvinetrañca nāgayajñopavītinam| kṛtāñjalipuṭopetaṃ dhyāyāmi balatoraṇam||(2nd line) oṃ hāṃ balatoraṇāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ balatoraṇādhipataye vajrāya namaḥ| toraṇaśākhayoḥ śvetavarṇaṃ dvinetrañca nāgayajñopavitiṇam| brahmāstragaṇḍikāyuktaṃ sāmavedaṃ natosmyaham|| oṃ hāṃ sāmavedāya namaḥ|(3rd line) oṃ hāṃ dvāparayugāya namaḥ| triśūle oṃ hāṃ godāvaryai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ umāyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ kāveryai namaḥ| dakṣiṇapatākāyām oṃ hāṃ bhūtasañjīvaṇāya namaḥ| uttarapatākāyāṃ (4th line)
oṃ hāṃ amṛtasañjīvaṇāya namaḥ| ūrddhvodumbare oṃ hāṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| dakṣiṇottaraśākhayoḥ oṃ hāṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ| (5th line) oṃ hāṃ bhadrāyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ skandāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ śacīsutāyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ vaśiṇyai namaḥ| adhodumbare oṃ hāṃ astrāyadvarapālāya namaḥ| uttare (oṃ) hāṃ tavargāya namaḥ|(6th line) oṃ hāṃ pavargāya namaḥ| dvāroparisthitadhvaje oṃ hāṃ aṅgārāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ iti sampūjya| uttaradvāramastreṇa samprokṣya|(7th line) kavacenāvakuṇṭhyā(ṭhya)| toraṇamaddhye oṃ hāṃ ārogyatoraṇāsanāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ ārogyatoraṇamūrttaye namaḥ| dvibhujañca dvinetrañca pārśvayorlambakeśiṇam| daṃṣṭrākarālavadanamārogyatoraṇaṃ yajet||(8th line ) oṃ hāṃ ārogyatoraṇāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ ārogyatoraṇādhipataye nīlalohitāya namaḥ| toraṇaśākhayoḥ kṛṣṇañcaturbhujaṃ dhvakṣaṃ kamaṇḍalvakṣasūtriṇam| (F.3a 1st line) athavedañcahastābhyāmañjalīṃ dadhataṃ yajet|| oṃ hāṃ atharvedāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ kaliyugāya namaḥ| triśūle oṃ hāṃ śoṇabhadrāyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ bhāgīrathyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ aṅgabhadrāyai namaḥ| dvārapaścimapatākāyāṃ(2nd line) oṃ hāṃ dhanadāya namaḥ| pūrvapatākāyāṃ oṃ hāṃ śrīpradāya namaḥ| ūrddhvodumbare oṃ hāṃ gaṇpataye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| paścimapūrva śākhayoḥ oṃ hāṃ devyai namaḥ|(3rd line) oṃ hāṃ caṇḍeśvarāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ rūpiṇyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ bhātiri śaktaye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ kuberāya namaḥ| adhodumbare oṃ hāṃ astrāyadvārapālāya namaḥ|(4th line) yavargāya namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ śavargāya namaḥ| dvāroparisthitaddhvje oṃ hāṃ rāhave namaḥ| oṃ hām ketave nama| īśānakoṇaddhvaje oṃ hāṃ īśānaya namaḥ|(5th line) oṃ hāṃ harṣaṇī śaktaye namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ brahmaṇe namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| oṃ hāṃ sadāśivādi gurubhyo namaḥ| eteṣāmāvāhaṇādi sarvopacāraissampūjya|(6th line) pūrvadvārebhyottara varddhanyāṃ oṃ haiṃ śāntikalā dvārāsaṇāya namaḥ| oṃ haiṃ śāntikalādvāramūrtaye namaḥ| caturvaktrā caturbāhuḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā mahābalā| ddhvajābhyākṣamālābja śāntissarpopavītini||(7th line)
oṃ haiṃ śāntikalāyai namaḥ| jya taduttaravarddhaṇyāṃ oṃ sāmaṃbikāsanāya namaḥ| oṃ sāmambikāmūrtaye namaḥ| caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāñca akṣamālākamaṇḍalūm| vahantimaṃbikāddhyāyedvaradābhayahastakām||(8th line)
oṃ hām aṃbikāyai namaḥ| jyaḥ dvāradakṣiṇavarddhanyāṃ gaṇāmbikāsanāyai namaḥ caturbhujāṃ triṇetrāñca pāśāṃkuśadharāṃ śubhāṃ| varadābhaya saṃyuktāṃ dhyāyecaiva gaṇāmbikāṃ||(F.3b 1st line) oṃ hāṃ gaṇāmbikāyai namaḥ| jyaḥ dakṣiṇadvārasya pūrvavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hāṃ vidyākalādvārāsanāyai namaḥ| raktavarṇākapardendu trivaktrāca caturbhujā| śaktyābhyākṣamālābjā vidyājvalanasannibhā|(2nd line) oṃ hāṃ vidyākalāyai namaḥ| tatpūrvavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hāṃ gaṅgāsanāyai namaḥ| triṇetrāṃ śvetavarṇāñca mṛgaṭaṅka dharāṃśubhāṃ| varadābhayasamyuktāṃ gaṅgāṃ makara saṃsthitām||(3rd line) oṃ hāṃ gaṅgāyai namaḥ dvārapaścimavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hāṃ gauryai namaḥ| kṛṣṇāñcaturbhujāṃ gaurī paṅkajotpaladhāriṇīṃ| varadābhaya samyuktāṃ ddhyāyetsarvārtha siddhaye|| oṃ sāṃ gauryai namaḥ(4th line) | paścimadvārsyadakṣiṇavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hāṃ nivṛttikalādvārāsanāyai namaḥ| taptacāmi karaśchāyā caturvaktrendu bhūṣitā| vajrābhayākṣamālābjā nivṛtti sarva siddhidā||(5th line)
oṃ hāṃ nivṛttikalāyai namaḥ| jya| taddakṣiṇavarddhaṇyāṃ oṃ sām umāsanāyai namaḥ| nīlavarṇāmumāñcaiva śaṃkhacakra dharāṃ śubhāṃ| varadābhaya samyuktāṃ lokānda gṛhakāriṇīm||(6thline)
oṃ sām umāyai namaḥ|jya| dvārottaravarddhanyām oṃ dhām īśvaryāsanāyai namaḥ caturbhujāṃ dvinetrāñca nānālaṅakāraśobhitaṃ| (7th line)
akṣacāpābja saṃyuktāṃ abhītivaradānvitām|| oṃ sāmīśvaryai namaḥ |jya| uttaradvārasyapaścimavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hvīṃ pratiṣṭhākalādvārāsanāyai namaḥ śuddhasphaṭika saṃkāśāñcaika vaktrā caturbhujā| (8th line)
pāśābhayākṣ mālābjā pratiṣṭhāratva bhūṣitā|| oṃ hvīṃ pratiṣṭhākalāyai namaḥ| jya| tatpaścimavarddhanyāṃ oṃ hāṃ manonmaṇyāsanāyai namaḥ| triṇetrāṃ raktavarṇāñca abjadvaya karānvitaṃ|(F.4a 1st line)
abhītivaradāṃ devīṃ sarvābharaṇasamanvitām|| oṃ hāṃ manonmaṇyai namaḥ| maddhyākāśoparisthitaddhvaje oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāsanāyai namaḥ| śvetavarṇaṃ dvinetrñca karaṇḍamakuṭānvitaṃ |(2nd line)
paṅkajotpalahastāñca abhītivaradānvitam|| o hāṃ dhārikāyai namaḥ| jy|maddhyākāśopariddhvaje oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāsanāyai namaḥ| śuddhasphaṭika saṃkāśā pañcavaktrā caturbhujā|(3rd line)
pāśābhayākṣamālābjā śāntyatīta varapradā|| oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāyai namaḥ| ityabhyarcya paścimadvāre nityavadvārapālānārāddhya tadyathā| (4th line) dvāramastreṇa saṃprokṣya| dvārorddhve dakṣiṇavāmamaddhyeṣu oṃ hrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ narmadāyai namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ sarasvatyai namaḥ| dvāradakṣiṇa pārśve oṃ hrīṃ gaṃgāyai namaḥ(5th line) | oṃ hrīṃ yoginyai namaḥ| vāma pārśve oṃ hrīṃ yamunāyai namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ ḍākinyai namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ sindhave namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ godāvaryai namaḥ|(6thline) adhodumbare maddhyeṣu oṃ hrīṃ kāveryai namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ śaṃkhanidhaye namaḥ| oṃ hrīṃ padmanidhaye namaḥ| agre vṛṣabhāya namaḥ| ityabhyarcya pādyādikaṃ datvā mūlāstra pāśupadāstra (7th line) divyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭha vighnaṃnirasyā nnyastreṇa saṃghaṭya paścimadvāreṇa adhodumbare maddhye ca| caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ pradīptāgni samaprabham| dakṣavāmakramāśśakti śūlābhayavarānvitā|(8th line)
oṃ hrīṃ astrāya dvārapālāya namaḥ ityabhyarcya kiñcidvāmaśākhāṃ (n) samāśrayan dakṣiṇapādapurassaramantaḥ praviśya yāgaśālāṃ pradakṣiṇa(F.4b 1st line) krameṇa naiṛte sthitvā maṇḍapaṃ triṇādīnāchśāditañcet| kampyādiṣu oṃ hāṃ pṛthvitatvāya namaḥ| tṛṇeṣu oṃ hāmaptatatvāya namaḥ| bandheṣu oṃ hāṃ tejastatvāyanamaḥ|(2nd line) vaṃśeṣu oṃ hāṃ vāyutatvāya namaḥ| stambeṣu oṃ hāmakāśa tatvāya namaḥ| cūḻikāyāṃ śivāya namaḥ| vitāneṣu vajrāya namaḥ| taraṃgeṣu oṃ hāṃ jāhnavyai namaḥ| darbhamālāyāṃ(3rd line) oṃ hāṃ vasukyai namaḥ| aṃkaṇe oṃ hāmugarāya namaḥ| diśāsu oṃ haḥ astrāya namaḥ| upavedi paritaḥ pūrvādiśānāntam| urvaśīdhṛtadarpaṇe darpaṇadhipataye sūryāya namaḥ(4th line) uṣādevyai namaḥ menakā dhṛtapūrṇakumbhe pūrṇakumbādhipataye jaleśvarāya namaḥ jāhnvyai namaḥ raṃbhādhṛttahamse haṃsādhipataye(5th line ) īśvarāya namaḥ umāyai namaḥ tilottamādhṛta yugmacāmare yugmacāmarādhipataye mātariśvane namaḥ kālyai namaḥ sumukhidhṛtaśrīvatse śrīvatsādhipataye mahālakṣmyai namaḥ(6th line)
bhūdevyai namaḥ sundaridhṛta svastike svastikādhipataye namaḥ raudryai namaḥ svāhādevyai namaḥ kāmukidhṛta śaṃkhe śaṃkhādhipataye vimalāya namaḥ (7th line) śaśidevyai namaḥ kāmavardhanidhṛta dīpe dīpādhipataye agnijihvāya namaḥ svadhādevyai namaḥ iti sampūjya| śakti tatvāntavyāpakaṃ maṇṭapaṃ vibhāvya paścādvedikṣiṇataḥ kūrmāsane(8th line) vyāghrājinādau udanmukhau ssamupaviśya bhūta śuddhyantaryajanahavanadhyānaśivahastaṃ kuryāt tato saptadhāstra japta mādāya svadakṣiṇa kaṭyāṃ baddhvā pañcagavyaṃ vidhivat sādhayet (F.5a 1st line) tato lāja candana siddhārtha bhasmapuṣpa kuśākṣatān saptasaṃkhyān śuddhalājān vikirānastreṇa saptadhābhimantrya śuddhapātre saṅgṛhya jñānakhaḍgaṃ tadupari (2nd line) nikṣipya pāśupadāstreṇa saptadhābhimantrya nirīkṣaṇādibhirviśoddhya samhitayābhimantryā naiṛtesthitvā nirīkṣaṇādi catuṣpadhānt samskāraissaṃskṛtya tadyathā mūleṇa nirīkṣaṇaṃ(3rd line) astreṇa prokṣaṇaṃ kuśaiḥ huṃphaḍanta astreṇa tāḍanaṃ vauṣaḍantakavacenātabhyukṣaṇaṃ
